Depends on collecting the items; the hand-ins take about 3 hours (includes 2 hours of waiting)

The addons of the {wiki:Warrior Outfits|Warrior Outfit}, the lighter version of the knight outfit. You get the first addon (spiked shoulder pads) from {npc:Trisha}, leader of the knights' guild in Carlin, and it is made by {npc:Cornelia}. The second addon (the sword) is forged by {npc:Morgan}, in Sabrehaven. With both addons you get the achievement Wild Warrior.
The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save energy and keep your agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
Premium Account (the base outfit can be chosen by any Premium player; this quest only gives the addons).
No minimum level (100+ recommended to collect the items).
For addon 2: access to Meriana (the *Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}), so that {npc:Captain Waverider} takes you to Sabrehaven with the password *peg leg*.
Gather **all** the items before talking to the NPCs: you can collect them before starting the quest.
You need 100 {item:Hardened Bone|Hardened Bones}, 100 {item:Turtle Shell|Turtle Shells}, 1 {item:Spirit Container} and 1 {item:Dragon Claw}.

Get a {item:Dragon Claw} by killing {creature:Demodras}. He may appear in the Dragon Lair of the Plains of Havoc (on the way to the Ornamented Shield Quest), in the PoI Dragon Lair or in the Thais Dragon Lair (on the way to the Naginata Quest). To leave, go back the same way you entered the lair.
Demodras is a dragon boss: go well prepared or in a group.
Trade **2 {item:Royal Helmet|Royal Helmets}** for a {item:Spirit Container|Fighting Spirit} at the Djinn fortress, or collect Spirit Containers from {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}.
2. Addon 1: handing in to Trisha and Cornelia
Go to the knights' guild in **Carlin** and talk to {npc:Trisha}: say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:earn}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}.

With all the items in your inventory, talk to {npc:Trisha} again: say {key:hi}, then {key:hardened bones} and {key:yes}, {key:turtle shells} and {key:yes}, {key:fighting spirit} and {key:yes}, and finally {key:dragon claw} and {key:yes}.
Ordering the shoulder spikes from Cornelia
Go to {npc:Cornelia}, the armour seller just **south** of the Carlin depot. Say {key:hi} and {key:spike} ({key:armor}, {key:Trisha}, {key:addon} or {key:outfit} also work).
Wait 2 hours and get the addon
Wait **two hours** and talk to {npc:Cornelia} again: {key:hi} and {key:spike}.
You need 100 {item:Iron Ore} and 1 {item:Piece of Royal Steel}.
Collect **100** {item:Iron Ore} by killing {wiki:Dwarves|dwarves}, {creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems} or {creature:War Golem|War Golems}.

Trade a {item:Crown Armor} for a {item:Piece of Royal Steel} with {npc:A Sweaty Cyclops} in Ab'Dendriel ({wiki:The Sweaty Cyclops Quest}). He lives in a tower **northeast** of the depot: go through a small cave of {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} beneath the wheat field **east** of the depot, in Underwood, and climb up to the tower's **4th floor**. To leave, go down and return through the same cave. Before that you have to give him **3 {item:Bast Skirt|Bast Skirts}**. To the cyclops, the Piece of Royal Steel is called **"Uth'Kean"**.

Go to **Sabrehaven**, on the island of {wiki:Meriana}: at the **Liberty Bay** harbour, on the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} and say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes} (50 gp). In Sabrehaven, talk to {npc:Morgan}. Say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:weapons} and {key:warrior's sword}. Then say {key:forge} and {key:warrior's sword} again to hand over the items.
To go back to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp).
With both addons you have the complete Warrior Outfit and earn the achievement **Wild Warrior**.
